notablePrerequisites: Distinguished Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Distinguished Conjurer's ability by paying {4}{W} and tapping it, blinking Peregrine Drake.
Peregrine Drake, Distinguished Conjurer, and Intruder Alarm all trigger.
Resolve Distinguished Conjurer's trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Peregrine Drake's trigger, untapping five lands.
Repeat.
